description: This Python source file defines a class SimpleTextAggregator for basic sentence boundary detection in text processing, specifically for TTS scenarios. It includes methods for aggregating text, detecting sentence boundaries with lookahead, flushing remaining text, and handling interruptions.

classes.name: SimpleTextAggregator
classes.description: A class that accumulates text until sentence boundaries are detected, suitable for TTS text processing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the text aggregator with an empty buffer and lookahead flag.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Property that returns the currently accumulated text as an Aggregation object.

methods.name: aggregate
methods.description: Asynchronously processes input text character-by-character, yielding complete sentences.

methods.name: _check_sentence_with_lookahead
methods.description: Implements core sentence detection logic with lookahead to confirm sentence boundaries.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes remaining text in the buffer as a final sentence.

methods.name: handle_interruption
methods.description: Handles processing interruptions by clearing the text buffer.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state and clears accumulated text.
